entities.name: Atrahasis Epic
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: A Babylonian epic (Old Babylonian period, c. 1700 BCE) that narrates the creation of humanity by the gods, the subsequent overpopulation crisis, divine attempts to reduce humanity through plague and famine, and culminates in the Great Flood sent by Enlil. The hero Atrahasis (meaning "exceedingly wise") is warned by the god Enki to build an ark, surviving the deluge with his family and animals. This narrative predates and directly influences the Gilgamesh Tablet XI flood story and the Genesis flood narrative, making it a critical link in the chain of ancient Near Eastern flood traditions.
